3 Alibaba Scams That WIL RUIN Your Clothing Brand. If you’re working with a manufacturer on Alibaba, watch out for these common scams that I’ve seen happen time and time again. 1️⃣ Fabric Shortage Scam – You order a 400gsm hoodie, but they secretly swap it for 350gsm to save money. Always check bulk orders carefully. Its difficult to determine the gsm of a fabric just based on feel, so cut out a uniform section of the fabric, weigh it and calculate the gsm yourself. 2️⃣ FOB Shipping Surprise – Most Alibaba manufacturers use FOB shipping, meaning you have to pay customs fees when the order arrives. The manufacturer won’t tell you that you’re going to be getting a significant bill from customs for tax and duty. So avoid this by requesting DDP shipping (Delivered Duty Paid), so all taxes and duties are covered upfront and through the manufacturer which will save you a headache. 3️⃣ Sample vs. Bulk Scam – The sample from the manufacturer will be perfect, but when you place a bulk order, they cut corners—using lower GSM fabric, cheaper materials, or different stitching to save costs. This is one of the most common scams on Alibaba. Its pretty difficult to get around this one as of course you have to place a bulk order with them to see what you get. But this is why you should ONLY work with reputable manufacturers and not just the cheapest quote you get from Alibaba. In this industry, you truly get what you pay for. Pay peanuts, get monkeys.
